scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/voice.ts src/schema.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --external mediasoup --external react --external react-dom --external zod && dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.build.json --no-check -o dist/index.d.ts src/index.ts && dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.build.json --no-check -o dist/voice.d.ts src/voice.ts && dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.build.json --no-check -o dist/schema.d.ts src/schema.ts
scripts.magic: bun --bun run lint:fix && bun --bun run format && bun --bun run check-types
